text: And this is big news to us, but to him it must not be big news at all from what I've been reading here about his notes.

This is Mr. George Adamski. He's 73 years old, and he has books out called Inside the Spaceships, not Outside the Spaceships, but Inside the Spaceships, and Flying Saucers, Farewell, and so on and so on.
And I don't know just where to begin, Mr. Adamski.
He's lecturing tonight at the John Hancock Hall at 8 p.m.
You'll have some colored film with him there.
He's lecturing at the Algonquin Regional High School tomorrow night in Northborough at 8 p.m.
And you ought not to miss either one of those lectures.
Where do we begin about your knowing about flying saucers, not only that,
but seeing them, talking with the people inside of them, and riding with them in their craft?
Is all this supposed to be true?
Absolutely true.
And exactly when did this happen? How, when did you become interested in it?
Oh, I became interested, I was an amateur astronomer from year 25, and then 46, of course, was the first evidence of them,
and then 47, when Candid Arnold saw nine of them over Mount Rainier, Washington State,
and I become interested in it, although astronomy did not teach us that part, see?
So there was a little doubt, skepticism is what they were saying.
But as time went on, and then finally in 52, well, really in 51,
the U.S. Navy down there at Point Loma in San Diego was going up the biggest observatory,
and I lived on the slopes of Mount Pelimar at the time,
I would photograph the moon and things like that in space and send it to the lab, you know, the photographs that I would get.
And they were there interested, so I took that up, and still I wasn't fully convinced,
but they said to photograph the moon and what part of the moon that they were coming in on toward the moon.
And so I got some pictures, and I sent it there, and of course they didn't comment on it one way,
except that they said in one letter back to me, which is in my first book,
that it had nothing, they didn't think that this picture had anything to do with the visitors.
Well, if there were no visitors, they wouldn't have to mention them, see?
So they already knew then that it was visitors.
Then from there on, of course, went out to the desert and tried to get as many photographs
with a portable telescope that I had, a six-inch, I had a 15 also,
but I couldn't move that except the portable one.
Tried to get pictures out in the desert because there were reports,
ports kept coming in that they were landing out in the desert. So in 52, on November 20th,
I had six other people with me, and we were now out in the desert, and it, well, it was an accident.
We didn't expect anything except maybe catch something flying through space. When I said it,
made a contact with the individual of one of the ships. And you spoke with him? That's right.
How could they speak our language?
Well, at that time he didn't speak our language.
I had a job to convey my thoughts and receive his through gestures
and try to pass on thought impressions onto him, you know, and so on, and onto me.
But the next time I met him after that, well, he spoke English, and I asked him about that.
I said, Why don't you speak English? He didn't speak English first place.
and he says, well, I was testing you, see how good you were on receiving impressions.
We have no telephone system.
And that's the type of a man that appeared at that time.
And now there's a spacecraft, only one year old, last July.
I caught it where I live.
That's old Vista, California.
It's a colored movie, see?
Oh, I didn't see.
See how they move?
I do indeed.
Yeah.
we have nothing like that that moves that way.
See, I have repeats on it because it's short and long, so I repeat it.
I caught that on 3 o'clock in the afternoon in July,
the 10th year ago last July.
Are these people able to universally, if you spoke French, for instance,
would they be universally able to...
Well, I got reports that Norwegian girls,
Norwegian girls, that they talk to them in Norwegian, see?
Our time has completely run out here this morning.
around this neighborhood again, could we invite you back and talk to us more about it?
We'd be glad to.
Meanwhile, inside the spaceship, many others, written by Mr. George Adamski here, who has
been consulted by our government and who is considered quite a man, who have been inside
of spaceships and ridden with them and talking with their people, too.
Thank you so much for coming this morning, sir.
Our program continues right after this message.
